# 维沃移动通信有限公司
> vivo 官方网站，提供智能手机、IoT 设备、服务支持、开发者资源与企业信息。

vivo Global 面向全球用户展示 vivo 手机、平板、穿戴、音频与智能生态产品，同时提供支持服务、Funtouch OS 信息、开发者平台入口、新闻资讯与公司介绍。

## Products
- [Smartphones](https://www.vivo.com/en/products): Browse vivo smartphone lineup across flagship, V, Y, and other series.
- [X Series](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/x-series): Explore vivo X Series flagship phones focused on imaging and premium design.
- [V Series](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/v-series): View V Series smartphones emphasizing portrait photography and stylish aesthetics.
- [Y Series](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/y-series): Discover Y Series devices designed for everyday performance and value.
- [Accessories](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/accessories): Find vivo accessories and connected devices for the broader ecosystem.
- [Tablets](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/tablets): Explore vivo tablet products and large-screen device offerings.
- [Wearables](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/wearables): View vivo wearable devices for health tracking and smart connectivity.
- [Audio](https://www.vivo.com/en/products/audio): Discover vivo audio products including earbuds and related accessories.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.vivo.com/en/support): Access product help, service information, and customer support resources.
- [FAQs](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/question): Search frequently asked questions about vivo devices and services.
- [Service Center](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/service-center): Locate authorized vivo service centers for repairs and in-person assistance.
- [Warranty](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/warranty): Review warranty policies and coverage information for vivo products.
- [IMEI Authentication](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/imei): Verify device authenticity and related product identification details.
- [System Update](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/system-update): Learn about software updates and update methods for supported devices.
- [User Manuals](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/user-manual): Read or download official user manuals for vivo devices.
- [Spare Parts Price](https://www.vivo.com/en/support/spare-part-price): Check reference pricing for official replacement parts and repairs.
